from.place: Proof step 4: ordinary coefficient, identity and composition normalizations

title: Normalized ordinary coefficient, identity and composition comparisons
statement: For the adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], the canonical completed coefficient inverse images respect composition. The module direct image of the identity morphism has a unique natural identity isomorphism whose sections are restriction along the inverse fiber-product identity. Retain these normalizations to define ordinary derived pullback composition and identity maps, and their right-adjoint conjugates. These are precisely integralRingIso_comp and modulePushId_existsUnique and the comparison definitions of the attached module.

proof.text: Compare the completed coefficient inverse-image compositions after every finite quotient projection. The profinite coefficient inverse-image cocycle and naturality identify these composites, so limit uniqueness gives the claimed equality. The identity coefficient map is identified by the same projection argument.

For identity direct image, restriction along the inverse fiber-product identity gives a module map because the coefficient map is the identity inverse-image comparison. The inverse is the opposite restriction. Their composites are identities by functoriality; component and section extensionality gives uniqueness. Derive the conjugate pullback identity and retain the normalized composition comparison.
